title: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in Westell…
description: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in Westell Technologies Remote series products on Linux, affecting devices configured for Remote Access Server (RAS) functionality. The flaw involves improper neutralization of special elements in OS commands, allowing potential injection attacks. It impacts multiple generations of Westell Remotes through firmware version 9.14. The vulnerability has a critical severity rating with a CVSS score of 9.5.
